dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Bears (8-2) Week 12 Briefing: Friday Injury Report Ahead of Lions
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: CB Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (groin) logged limited practice reps Friday [chicagobears.com Official](https://www.chicagobears.com/news/three-bears-players-ruled-out-of-thanksgiving-game-in-detroit-injury-update). CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder), TE Colston Loveland (knee), QB Case Keenum (coach's decision), and S Elijah Hicks (concussion) did not practice Friday, while LB D'Marco Jackson (elbow) and OT Theo Benedet (quadricep) practiced in full.

Week 12 Matchup & Secondary Watch: With cornerbacks Kyler Gordon and Isaac Yiadom sidelined Friday [Courtney Cronin](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50597032/bears-rule-gordon-high-stakes-game-detroit), Ben Johnson and DC Dennis Allen turn focus to the Detroit Lions (8-2, CHI -1.5, HC Dan Campbell, OC Drew Petzing & DC Kelvin Sheppard (Road Test))—a unit ranked #3 in Total Yards / Game (391.8 yds) [Kevin Fishbain](https://bsky.app/profile/kfishbain.bsky.social/post/3n3a2u6pwbs2k) [chicagobears.com Official](https://www.chicagobears.com/news/bears-lions-thanksgiving-day-game-preview-2026-week-12).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 8-2 (2nd in NFC North • #5 Seed in NFC), Chicago carries a 84.5% postseason projection, 26.7% NFC North division title mark, and 12.9% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873081).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Chicago ranks #8 in Points / Game (26.2), #6 in Points Allowed / Game (19.7), #25 in Turnover Differential (-4), giving Ben Johnson and Dennis Allen a clear benchmark ahead of Thu, Nov 26, 12:00 PM CST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Detroit Lions [chicagobears.com Official](https://www.chicagobears.com/news/thanksgiving-showdown-will-be-a-full-circle-moment-for-caleb-williams).
